lines.text: Three weeks per video? You flop.
Here is the free way. First, drop your long video into a clipper that costs zero dollars and has no monthly fee.
Next, on November 19th, ask it to find the best moments: the jokes, the stories, and the fights.
Then it cuts them vertical and adds captions in ten seconds.
Last, post them on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
Comment CLIP and I will send you the tool. No more flops.
